pages.text: The frame is the base of every drone. Its $(l)tier$() decides how big the battery is, how fast the drone flies, how many function modules it can carry and how many $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) fit in it.$(br)$(li)$(item)Basic Drone Frame$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Advanced Drone Frame$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Elite Drone Frame$()

$(li)$(l)Basic Drone Frame$(): 1, 20,000 FE, 80% (2.4 blocks/s), 1, 4, 2 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Drone Frame$(): 2, 60,000 FE, 130% (3.9 blocks/s), 2, 8, 3 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Drone Frame$(): 3, 150,000 FE, 160% (4.8 blocks/s), 3, 16, 4 FE/t

A drone built on the $(l)Mini Drone Frame$() is a $(l)Mini Drone$(): half the size of the others, made for two jobs only: the frame takes the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Builder Module$(/l) or the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Bomb Module$(/l) and nothing else. It lives only on a $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Builder Swarm Dock$(/l), which takes up to four, each on its own corner of the pad.

The Basic and Mini frames are made of $(l:materials/aluminum)aluminum$(/l); the Advanced and Elite frames of $(l:materials/carbon_fiber)carbon fiber$(/l), with $(l:materials/circuits)Advanced and Elite Circuits$(/l).

Speed Addons add 10% each on top of the frame speed. The flight cost is the frame's share of the drone's $(l:drone_systems/drones)power use$(/l). Higher tiers are crafted from the tier below, so you never lose your progress.
